description.value: The Kilby Historic Site is BC's only reminder of the once-thriving community of Harrison Mills, centred on an original 1906 general store now filled with artifacts, hands-on activities, and costumed interpreters. The site encompasses heritage farm buildings, friendly farm animals, a café, and a 41-site campground — making it a rare attraction where touring cyclists can arrive, explore, eat, and camp all in one place. Celebrating its 120th anniversary, it sits in a scenic corner of the Fraser Valley within easy riding distance of Mission, Chilliwack, and Harrison Hot Springs.

address.value: 215 Kilby Road, Harrison Mills, BC V0M 1L0

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at kilby.ca is fully accessible and richly detailed. The contact page confirms street address (215 Kilby Road, Harrison Mills, BC V0M 1L0) and phone (604-796-9576), neither of which appeared in the OSM record. A café is explicitly and repeatedly confirmed on-site; however, no mention of bike parking, bike racks, washrooms, water refill, or any cyclist-specific amenities appears anywhere in the fetched content. OSM uses 'Kilby General Store' while the website consistently uses 'Kilby Historic Site' — flagged as a name discrepancy.
concerns: OSM name is 'Kilby General Store' but the business consistently presents itself as 'Kilby Historic Site' across its entire website — the general store is one exhibit within the broader site.
OSM community field lists 'Chilliwack' but the site is physically located in Harrison Mills, BC — a distinct community roughly 30 km from Chilliwack.
OSM record contains no address or phone; both were sourced from the website only, so contact_confirmed is null for those fields.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A legitimate, operating heritage attraction with an on-site café and 41-site campground; touring cyclists can combine a cultural stop with an overnight stay, making this a high-value listing for a cycling tourism directory.
enrichment_extras.notes: The campground (41 sites, most reservable online, six first-come-first-served) is a strong cyclist-relevant amenity worth confirming and highlighting if a site visit or direct inquiry can verify bike-specific facilities such as hose access, washrooms, or secure parking.

Café or food on site.detail: Kilby Cafe is an on-site café confirmed throughout the website; the group tours page shows a sandwich menu served in the café or tea garden, and picnic tables are available on the grounds

peak.label: Peak season: farm animals, hands-on activities

wow_evidence: Kilby Historic Site — 1906 general store museum with costumed interpreters, heritage farm, café, and campground; provincial heritage property (Hat Creek band). Rename to the site.
